scope: Forge 47.4.10 development client with same-ID fixture items, installed Grilling, Cookery, ImmersiveEating, GeckoLib, Embeddium and Mekalus. Both complete nine-item runs use a window hidden before creation and disabled shaders, with slim and Steve arms, base interactions and rapid selection tests. All 24 hand masks and native skin/sleeve meshes validated for both hand sizes and dominant hands. 48 Blockbench projects exported from 1.6.3 runtime transforms. Motion refinement preserves timing, bottle geometry, grip targets and sounds; force-continuous reversals, launch/catch velocity, facet holds, four swallow responses and camera endpoints are tested. Runtime liquid inertia and polygon clipping are not reproduced in Blockbench. Full modpack not tested.
